title: Highlight radius mixes units: tile-space dx/dy tested against 8*tile_px, so every pipe on the map passes the filter
evidence: app/render/spawn_fx.odin:451 `rad := f32(SPAWN_HIGHLIGHT_RADIUS_TILES) * v.tile_px` ... :464-466 `dx := f32(mid[0]) - f32(r.pos[0])` / `dy := f32(mid[1]) - f32(r.pos[1])` / `if dx * dx + dy * dy > rad * rad {` — node positions are TILES: app/render/view.odin:128-129 `node_screen :: proc(v: ^View, pos: [2]i32) -> rl.Vector2 {` / `return to_screen(v, f32(pos[0]) * v.tile_px, f32(pos[1]) * v.tile_px)`; data/balance.json:78 `"tile_px": 26`. dx/dy are tile deltas but rad = 8*26 = 208, so the gate is tile_dist² ≤ 208² = 43264 while the 40×30 map's max squared distance is 39²+29² = 2362.
detail: The distance test compares tile-unit deltas against a pixel-unit radius: effective radius is 208 tiles, not 8 — every live pipe pulses on every spawn, defeating the neighborhood intent.
recommended_fix: Compare in one unit: `rad := f32(SPAWN_HIGHLIGHT_RADIUS_TILES)` against the tile-space dx/dy (drop `* v.tile_px`), or compare screen-space node_screen distances; pin with a test asserting a far pipe is excluded.

title: `T - SPAWN_LEAD_TICKS` wraps when terminal_spawn_interval_ticks < 10 — the telegraph is predicted but never drawn
evidence: app/render/spawn_fx.odin:323-325 `T := fx.telegraph.spawn_tick` / `if tick < T - SPAWN_LEAD_TICKS || tick > T + SPAWN_BURST_TICKS {` — T is a multiple of interval (`:274 window := tick + u64(interval) - (tick % u64(interval))`), and core/catalog.odin:842-845 only enforces `if tsi < 1 || tms < 1 { return {"balance.json", "terminal_spawn_interval_ticks/terminal_min_sep_tiles", "must be >= 1 with all keys present (the growth cadence + the E31 packing floor)"} }`.
detail: With interval ∈ [1,9] (catalog-legal), windows below 10 exist; u64 T-10 wraps huge, `tick < huge` is always true, so the ring silently never draws for those windows.
recommended_fix: Compute in signed space or guard: `if T < SPAWN_LEAD_TICKS || tick < T - SPAWN_LEAD_TICKS ...` — or reject terminal_spawn_interval_ticks < SPAWN_LEAD_TICKS at catalog load.
